errors.text_span: като всеки от тях е маркиран с етикет и процентна стойност, която е изписана вътре в сектора
errors.evidence: This statement is incorrect on two points: 1) The text labels ('етикет') are located in the legend, not inside the sectors. 2) Not every sector has a percentage value; the green sector is missing its value.
The orange sector represents 41.3%, which is not the largest. The red sector is the largest at 43.5%.

errors.text_span: Вторият по големина сектор, с червен цвят
errors.evidence: The red sector is the largest at 43.5%, not the second largest. The orange sector (41.3%) is the second largest.
